answer: Bind each seat to a web domain it has run for months. A key joins by posting a signed TXT record on a domain whose certificate transparency log shows HTTPS certs issued for 6+ months with no gap. Weight starts at its nadir and thaws at glacier pace, reaching full only after 12 months. One extra identity costs ~$12/yr plus that wait, so 100 fakes registered at dawn today vote at full weight next November. Seats sharing a registrar account, nameserver or host IP merge. Failure mode: aged domains bought on drop-catch markets, so an RDAP registrant change resets the clock.
